scenes.title: 찾은 위치에서 기준점 선택으로
lines: The previous lecture described a triangle position by vertex weights. Where should we place a reference marker? The answer changes with what we want to make equal.

scenes.title: 같은 비율은 좌표의 평균입니다
lines: Equal one-third vertex weights give the coordinate average. For a uniformly dense paper triangle, this connects to its balance point. We have not imposed equal distances to edges or vertices.

scenes.title: 움직이는 건물의 기준점과 외곽
lines: In Tiny Glade, place a building and change its size and position. Blue marks an observed reference; choosing one reference does not replace its complete outline.
In a separate shot, rotate a building and change its height. Its outline changes even with a similar center marker. This is an observed screen reference, not a claim about internal game calculations.

scenes.title: 각을 반으로 나누면 왜 변에서 같은 거리일까요?
lines: Drop perpendiculars from an interior point to two sides. On the angle bisector, the two right triangles are congruent, giving equal perpendicular distances.

Join a point equally distant from all three sides to the vertices. The three small triangles share the same radius as height. Their areas, and hence the barycentric area weights from the previous lecture, are proportional to their opposite side lengths.

scenes.title: 변의 중점에서 직각으로 세우는 이유
lines: We have solved equal distances to sides. Now require equal distances to vertices. A perpendicular line through the midpoint of two points consists of positions equally distant from them. This is the perpendicular bisector.

scenes.title: 벽을 바꾸면 안과 밖의 경계도 바뀝니다
lines: A wall stroke creates an open arch. Red follows the observed wall boundary.
In a separate shot, erase and redraw a wall, then run a path through it. Watch both the remaining wall and empty opening: the full boundary conveys more than one center point.

scenes.title: 선을 이어서 남겨야 할 땅을 정합니다
lines: A single center cannot describe the land shape. Connect boundary points in order and close the path to distinguish retained area from empty space. We now move from choosing a center to preserving a boundary.

scenes.title: 높이 변화와 평면의 홈을 구분합니다
lines: Tiny Glade changes terrain height. Different heights cannot automatically be treated as one planar boundary.
In a separate Noita cave, pass through a narrow opening and move toward the right ledge. Red follows visible land versus empty space. Bridging a notch could create land outside the original shape.

scenes.title: 회전의 부호는 어느 쪽으로 꺾였는지입니다
lines: The segment crossing empty space showed that the L is concave. Turning along its boundary checks the same property numerically. At its notch, travel three left and then three up: the2D cross product is minus nine, the opposite turn from the other vertices.

scenes.title: 경계를 정했으니 안쪽을 나눌 차례입니다
lines: We chose centers by their purpose and found the notch in an ordered boundary. A boundary defines the outside, but does not yet partition the interior. The next episode divides this L while preserving its empty region.

scenes.title: 땅은 남기고 빈 공간은 채우지 않는 분할
lines: The previous episode separated center purposes and boundary order, then found the L-shaped notch. We now partition that land into triangles with disjoint interiors.
Start with a simple convex method and see why it can fail at a notch. Remove ears one by one, then verify the original area and narrow openings remain.

scenes.title: 호수와 동굴의 빈 부분을 남깁니다
lines: Drawing a lake changes the remaining land boundary. The water-side notch is excluded from the land.

In a separate Noita shot, descend through empty space beside a stepped outline. Watch red edges and yellow empty space. This familiar source now asks about partition coverage rather than the preceding lecture’s distance.

scenes.title: 넓이 합은 덮은 모양을 알려주지 않습니다
lines: A fan can cover the notch despite giving the expected number of triangles. A signed area sum is like a ledger total: matching totals do not reveal where each amount went. Similarly, an equal area sum does not establish coverage at each location.

scenes.title: 빼도 되는 작은 조각을 먼저 찾습니다
lines: Joining everything at once covered empty space. Instead, test one small triangle from three neighboring points. Even a convex corner cannot be removed if its diagonal crosses the boundary or the triangle contains another remaining point. Store it as an ear only when its interior and vertex checks pass.

scenes.title: 조각을 떼어도 통로의 모양은 남습니다
lines: Descend and return upward between platforms in this Noita interval. Red follows visible boundaries. Compare the movement with the requirement that removing an ear preserves the original empty passage.

scenes.title: 사라진 것은 점의 번호가 아니라 연결입니다
lines: Original vertex IDs remain after saving the first ear. In the remaining boundary, vertex zero now connects to vertex two. Update adjacency after each removal to find the next valid ear.

scenes.title: 잘라 낸 조각이 무엇을 남기는지 확인합니다
lines: Shapez2 cuts a disk and sends out two pieces.
A separate shot also cuts a square. Watch where the pieces emerge. This is not evidence of a triangulation implementation.

scenes.title: 길이 눈금이 두 배면 넓이는 네 배입니다
lines: Improve triangle shape only after validating coverage. Doubling coordinate scale doubles both base and height, so area quadruples. Length and area tolerances must therefore use different units and scales.
A thin triangle has a small altitude, making the same position error relatively larger. Compare valid candidates rather than erasing the passage.

scenes.title: 좁은 통로를 지우지 않고 경계를 따라갑니다
lines: Climb a narrow Noita corridor, then descend to a wider area. Long edges meet nearby corners. Once the area banner passes, look at the same passage again. Simplification must not erase this opening.
A separate factory shot: follow the bent path in order.

scenes.title: 중심부터 분할까지 같은 질문으로 돌아갑니다
lines: Different triangle areas also mean different weights for a uniformly dense plate center. Pieces of area two and one point five contribute in those proportions. Return to the final problems remembering that valid partition lets us calculate positions and surface values correctly.
